motor_name: ML Experiment / Model Training & Evaluation Engine

summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the motor_031 contract: it validates aligned synthetic dataset, expert spec and version inputs, enforces the motor_031 model-selection policy, emits only non-deployable training/evaluation/report records, preserves required synthetic-chain flags and limitations, and rejects malformed, lineage-invalid or production-like requests before publishing outputs.

findings: The public entry point accepts synthetic_dataset from motor_030, expert_problem_spec from motor_029, motor_002 version_records and optional experiment_config, matching the declared contract.

Successful runs emit training_run_record, model_eval_summary and capability_demonstration_report with stable IDs, shared source_problem_ref, expert_spec_ref, training_data_ref, generator_version, parameter_set and version references.
Candidate model families are derived from the declared problem_class policy, and the mandatory baseline must appear first before complex candidates can be evaluated.
Model selection applies the ordered criteria for primary metric threshold, scenario stability, generator sensitivity and simplest adequate model; non-selection remains valid when criteria fail.

The implementation rejects malformed inputs, unresolved critical ambiguity, unsupported problem classes, insufficient synthetic samples, lineage mismatches, skipped baselines and requested production artifacts with structured error codes.

All successful output objects include synthetic_data_flag=true, synthetic_support_flag=true, non_evidentiary_flag=true, intended_use=capability_demo, domain_validity_limits and an explicit limitations_note.

TrainingRunRecord, ModelEvalSummary and CapabilityDemonstrationReport include produced_by_motor=motor_031, produced_at, parent_id, version_id, created_at, updated_at and deterministic version_hash values.

CapabilityDemonstrationReport includes gap_to_real_validation, gap_to_deployment, known_failure_modes and cannot_substitute entries for field evidence, Validation Data Bridge, Verification Bridge and production deployment review.

The output surface contains reproducibility metadata and non-deployable training result references only; no serialized model, serving endpoint, deployment configuration or decision-grade artifact is produced.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Executable smoke checks covered the documented happy path, accepted output shape, selected-model rationale, required synthetic-chain flags on all emitted objects, produced_by_motor metadata, malformed input rejection and skipped-baseline policy rejection.
test_results.notes: Checks were run through implementation/codebase using .venv/bin/python3 and the public run_ml_experiment entry point. There is no standalone pytest suite in the artifact scope, but the smoke cases exercise the contract behaviors required by test_spec.md for conformance closure.
